title: OSTA — Old Spanish Textual Archive
notes: OSTA is the lemmatized/morphologically tagged ~35M-word corpus of 400+ semi-paleographic transcriptions of Old Spanish (including Asturleonese/Navarro-Aragonese) texts, begun 2015 by HSMS; the transcriptions and metadata are on GitHub (hispanicseminary/OSTA) and Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.18931376 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, verified live), which is exactly the RQ source ('OSTA Zenodo 18931376 -> TEXT.2CR', Cortes' Cartas de relación, Libro de albeiteria, Libro del abad don Juan etc.). Main search interface v2.0 verified live. RQ keeps the semi-paleographic text layer (not the lemmatized one). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Hispanic Seminary of Medieval Studies (HSMS); Francisco Gago Jover (College of the Holy Cross) & F. Javier Pueyo Mena
